name: Spartoo Marketplace
description: Spartoo marketplace web services for sellers: orders with customer and delivery details, accepting and shipping orders with a tracking number, returns, the status of a product on the site and stock updates per size. Partner code as a form field, XML answers read as JSON.
instructions:
## Spartoo Marketplace
This connector works with the **Spartoo marketplace web services** for merchants who sell on Spartoo (shoes, clothing, bags). It reads orders and returns, accepts and ships orders, checks whether a product is online and updates stock per size. Each web service is one address that takes form fields and answers in XML; the connector sends the partner code for you and hands the answer back as JSON under `root`.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. Sign in to the Spartoo marketplace back office and open **Documentation**, then **Webservices** and any service page, e.g. **Exporting orders**.
2. The line **Webservice URL** names the web service address of your Spartoo site, e.g. `https://sws.spartoo.eu` or `https://sws.spartoo.it`. Put the part before `/mp/` into `SPARTOO_HOST`.
3. On the same page the row `partner` shows your unique code when you are signed in. Put it into `SPARTOO_PARTNER_KEY`. If the page shows no code, ask your Spartoo marketplace contact for the web service code of your account.

**Where to start**: `spartoo_list_orders` with a start date. `spartoo_get_order` reads one order by its id.

**Orders**: an order arrives in status 11 (verified). `spartoo_accept_order` moves it to 2 (in preparation): after that its name, address and carrier can no longer change. `spartoo_ship_order` moves it from 2 to 3 (shipped) with the carrier's tracking number, and Spartoo emails the tracking link to the customer. `spartoo_cancel_order` (status 41) is installed switched off: the customer is refunded and it cannot be undone. Statuses 45 (parcel lost) and 47 (parcel not delivered) are set by Spartoo.

**Returns**: `spartoo_list_returns` and `spartoo_get_return`. One return holds one product. Return statuses: 2 waiting to be received, 3 refused, 4 parcel received and return accepted, 5 paid, 7 refund, 14 waiting for the merchant's prepaid return label. This connector does not accept or refuse returns.

**Products and stock**: `spartoo_check_product_status` says whether a product is on the site (`OK`), out of stock (`OS`), created but not yet online (`EC`) or unknown (`KO`), with the reason. `spartoo_update_stock` sets the stock of one size. Both use your own references: `reference_partenaire` is the product in one colour, `size_reference` one size of it. Stock 0 takes the size off the site.

**Field notes**
- Order ids and return ids are short codes such as `90D813EA1A2365A8`.
- The order date filter is written `YYYY-MM-DD:hh:mm:ss` with a colon between day and hour. The return date filter is a Unix timestamp in seconds. Spartoo does not document the time zone.
- Prices are decimal numbers in the currency of the order's site; `products_final_price` is the discounted unit price times the quantity.
- An order for a pickup point has `relay_info` instead of the delivery address.
- Text values arrive as strings, numbers included. One order or product in a list arrives as an object, several as an array.

**Errors**: every answer carries a code. 1 means no error. -1 and -2: the partner code is missing or unknown. -3: date or id missing. -4: wrong date format. -6 and -28: order or return not found. -8: tracking number refused. -9: the order already has that status. -19: wrong order of statuses (2 only from 11, 3 only from 2). -14: product not found. -16, -18 and -20: stock not changed (not possible, already that value, or the size is no longer valid). -30: order too old to ship, contact Spartoo. -428: account deactivated. -429: too many requests in one hour. The connector reports a negative code as a failed call.

**Not covered**: creating and editing products, prices and discounts (they go through an XML catalogue file), packing slips, and return decisions.
prerequisites: A Spartoo marketplace merchant account with web service access and its partner code, shown on the web service documentation pages of the back office. About 3 minutes.

SPARTOO_HOST.label: Web service address
SPARTOO_HOST.help: The address in the line Webservice URL of the Spartoo web service documentation, without the path: https://sws.spartoo.eu for spartoo.eu, https://sws.spartoo.com for spartoo.com and France, https://sws.spartoo.it for Italy, and so on.
SPARTOO_HOST.patternMessage: Use the Spartoo web service address with https:// and without a path, e.g. https://sws.spartoo.eu.

SPARTOO_PARTNER_KEY.label: Partner code
SPARTOO_PARTNER_KEY.help: Your unique web service code. Signed in to the Spartoo marketplace back office, open Documentation, Webservices, Exporting orders: the row partner shows it.
SPARTOO_PARTNER_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the partner code alone: letters and digits, no spaces.

verifyHints.401: Spartoo does not know this partner code (error -1 or -2). Copy it again from the web service documentation pages of your marketplace back office, and check that the web service address belongs to the same Spartoo site.
verifyHints.403: Spartoo answered that this account is deactivated for web services (error -428). Contact the Spartoo marketplace team.
verifyHints.404: Spartoo found no order or return with that id for this partner code (error -6 or -28).
verifyHints.rate_limited: Spartoo limits the number of web service calls per hour (error -429). Wait and try again later.

tools.name: spartoo_list_orders
tools.description: List the orders placed since a date, optionally only those in one status. Per order under `root.orders.order`: orders_id, customers (billing name, address, phone), delivery (name and address, or relay_info for a pickup point), payment_method, shipping_name, shipping_price, order_total, orders_status_id and orders_status_name, date_purchased, last_modified, and products (your reference, Spartoo's reference, name, brand, size, size reference, colour, quantity, unit price, discounted price, final price). No paging: narrow the date to keep the answer small. Read-only.

since.description: Orders placed from this moment on, written YYYY-MM-DD:hh:mm:ss with a colon between day and hour, e.g. 2026-11-01:00:00:00.

status.description: Only orders in this status: 11 verified (new, to accept), 2 in preparation (accepted), 3 shipped, 41 cancelled, 45 parcel lost, 47 parcel not delivered. Leave out for all.

tools.name: spartoo_get_order
tools.description: Read one order by its id: customer and delivery details (or the pickup point in relay_info), payment method, shipping name and price, order total, current status id and name, purchase and last change dates, and the ordered products with your references, sizes, quantities and prices. Read-only.

order_id.description: Spartoo order id, e.g. 90D813EA1A2365A8 (orders_id of spartoo_list_orders).

tools.name: spartoo_accept_order
tools.description: Accept a new order: moves it from status 11 (verified) to 2 (in preparation). After that the order's name, delivery address and carrier can no longer change. Fails with error -19 when the order is not in status 11 and -9 when it is already accepted.

order_id.description: Spartoo order id to accept (orders_id of spartoo_list_orders).

tools.name: spartoo_ship_order
tools.description: Mark an accepted order as shipped with the carrier's tracking number: moves it from status 2 to 3, and Spartoo emails the tracking link to the customer. The whole order ships in one parcel. Fails with error -19 when the order is not in status 2, -8 when the tracking number is refused and -30 when the order is too old.

order_id.description: Spartoo order id to ship; it must be in status 2 (accept it first).

tracking_number.description: Tracking number given by the carrier named in the order (shipping_name).

tools.name: spartoo_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order that has not shipped (status 41). The customer does not receive the order and is refunded by Spartoo; it cannot be undone and counts against the merchant. Not possible once the order is in status 3. Installed switched off.

tools.name: spartoo_list_returns
tools.description: List the returns registered since a moment, optionally only those in one status. Per return under `root.returns.return`: return_id, return_date, return_status and return_status_name, return_reason, the order id, and the returned product (your reference, Spartoo's reference, name, brand, size, colour). One return holds one product. Read-only.

since.description: Returns registered from this moment on, as a Unix timestamp in seconds, e.g. 1793491200.

status.description: Only returns in this status: 2 waiting to be received, 3 refused, 4 parcel received and accepted, 5 paid, 7 refund, 14 waiting for the merchant's prepaid return label. Leave out for all.

tools.name: spartoo_get_return
tools.description: Read the returns of one order, or one return by its id: return id and date, status id and name, reason, order id and the returned product with size and colour. Give return_id or order_id. Read-only.

return_id.description: Spartoo return id, e.g. EEAJBCC (return_id of spartoo_list_returns).

order_id.description: Spartoo order id: all returns of that order.

tools.name: spartoo_check_product_status
tools.description: Check whether one of your products is on the Spartoo site. Returns under `root.products.product` your reference, a status (OK on the site, OS not in stock, EC created but not yet online, KO not created in Spartoo's system) and a description with the reason when it is offline. Read-only.

product_reference.description: Your product reference (reference_partenaire: one model in one colour). Letters, digits, dash, underscore and full stop only.

tools.name: spartoo_update_stock
tools.description: Set the stock of one size of one product, in real time. Stock 0 takes that size off the site; a product whose sizes are all 0 goes offline. The size must have been created with a size reference. Fails with error -14 when the product is unknown, -18 when the stock already has that value and -20 when the size is no longer valid.

product_reference.description: Your product reference (reference_partenaire: one model in one colour).

size_reference.description: Your reference of the size to update (size_reference of the product, products_size_reference in orders).

quantity.description: New stock quantity for that size, in pieces. 0 takes the size off the site.
